# Homico

> Plan, design and build your home end-to-end — architects, raw materials, home services, and turnkey construction in one place.

Homico helps homeowners in India plan, design, and build their dream homes. It combines on-demand home services (plumbing, electrical, painting, etc.), interior renovation, a raw materials marketplace, and full turnkey construction with project tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, materials, and construction.
- [Home Services](/services): Book trusted home services — plumbing, electrical, painting, carpentry, AC service, cleaning, mason and labour.
- [Home Maintenance](/services/home-services): Inspection-based home maintenance bookings.
- [Renovation & Interiors](/services/renovation): Modular kitchens, false ceilings, interior design and full renovations.
- [Raw Materials](/services/materials): Quality-verified construction materials catalog with delivery.
- [Full Home Construction](/services/construction): Turnkey home construction with cost estimator and project tracking.
- [Planning](/services/planning): Architectural planning and design services.
- [Planning + Construction](/services/planning-construction): Combined planning and execution.
- [Workforce](/services/workforce): Hire skilled construction workforce.
- [Elevation Ideas](/services/elevation-ideas): Inspiration for home elevations.
- [Cost Estimator](/tools/estimator): Free AI-powered cost estimator for home construction.
- [Search](/search): Search across services, materials and designs.
